The '''K-13 FS Heavy Cannon''' was a type of portable [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Cartel Market" />
